title: Toddler in Custom Tractor Seat, 1950s Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Fred rigged this seat up for Stevie - he thought it great fun. 247B
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot capturing a toddler named Stevie sitting happily in a custom, improvised seat rigged up onto a walk-behind garden tractor in a grassy yard. An older woman stands behind the machinery in a casual house dress. The note on the reverse side notes that Fred engineered this unique seat for Stevie, highlighting mid-20th-century rural American family life, ingenuity, and makeshift play items.
